Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying highway and bridge tolling authority.

BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.56.075 and 2002 c 56 s 404 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The ((department)) commission shall approve for construction only p. 1 SSB 5139such toll roads as the legislature specifically authorizes or such tollfacilities as are specifically sponsored by a regional transportationinvestment district, city, town, or county.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.56.076 and 2002 c 56 s 403 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Upon approval of a majority of the voters within its boundariesvoting on the ballot proposition, and only for the purposes authorizedin RCW 36.120.050(1)(((f))) (g), a regional transportation investmentdistrict may ((impose)) authorize vehicle tolls on state routes whereimprovements financed in whole or in part by a regional transportationinvestment district add additional lanes to, or reconstruct lanes on,a highway of statewide significance. The department shall administerthe collection of vehicle tolls authorized on designated facilitiesunless otherwise specified in law, and the state transportationcommission, or its successor, shall be the tolling authority.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.56.270 and 2002 c 114 s 20 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The ((Lake Washington bridge and the)) 1950 Tacoma Narrows bridgein chapter 47.17 RCW made a part of the primary state highways of thestate of Washington((,)) shall, upon completion, be operated,maintained, kept up, and repaired by the department in the mannerprovided in this chapter, and the cost of such operation, maintenance,upkeep, and repair shall be paid from funds appropriated for the use ofthe department for the construction and maintenance of the primarystate highways of the state of Washington. This section does not applyto that portion of the Tacoma Narrows bridge facility first opened totraffic after June 13, 2002.
